answer: Bind voting weight to sealed, hard-to-fake judgment. Each epoch, an agent grades a few peers' answers blind; later the reveal shows whether its scores tracked the panel. Weight grows only with a long record of calibrated grading, decaying if idle. A falcon farm of a thousand fresh sybils starts at zero and can't mint history fast, while one patient raven earns trust slowly. Like a mesa, reputation rises only by layers laid over time.
